text:
Taskade MCP Server and Agent Plugin

Paste this to your agent:

 

 Taskade is the AI-native workspace for projects, AI agents and automations. Taskade Genesis builds a running app from one prompt. 

 Connect Taskade to Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Windsurf and any other client of the Model Context Protocol. 

 
 
 

 Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http taskade 

 
 
 

 Hosted server: (Streamable HTTP, OAuth). Nothing to install.

 

This repo holds the Taskade agent plugin and two packages:

- MCP Server ( @taskade/mcp-server ): the local stdio server, for clients that cannot connect to a remote server.
- OpenAPI Codegen: generate MCP tools from any OpenAPI spec, not only Taskade.

---

 Agent plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI and Cursor

The taskade plugin connects your AI tool to your Taskade workspace through the hosted server, and adds skills: a front door ( taskade ) and the job skills ( getting-started , import-spreadsheet , fix-my-app , app-report , backup-my-app , plan-new-app ). The skills tell the agent which tools to call, in which order, and what to check before it reports back.

- Plan: MCP access is part of every paid Taskade plan (Starter and up). Sign in once with your Taskade account.
- What it does: imports a spreadsheet into a project, fixes a Taskade Genesis app one checked change at a time, reports on your projects and automations, backs up an app to a folder, and plans a new app.
- What stays in Taskade: the plugin cannot build an app, add fields to a project, or create or edit an automation. For those jobs, it writes the request for Taskade EVE. For a new app, it gives you a link that fills in the request and starts nothing. You publish an app and connect a domain in Taskade. For who can use an app, Taskade EVE proposes the setting and you apply it.

 Host Install 
 --- --- 
 Claude Code claude plugin marketplace add taskade/mcp , then claude plugin install taskade@taskade . Run /mcp , select taskade and sign in. 
 Codex codex plugin marketplace add taskade/mcp , then codex plugin add taskade@taskade 
 GitHub Copilot CLI copilot plugin install taskade/mcp 
 Gemini CLI gemini extensions install 
 VS Code See below 
 Cursor See below 
 Any other agent npx skills add taskade/mcp installs the skills only. Then add the hosted server to the agent and sign in (see the quick start). 

 VS Code: turn on the chat.plugins.enabled setting. Then run Chat: Install Plugin From Source from the Command Palette and enter 

 Cursor: the Cursor plugin taskade ( .cursor-plugin/ ) in this repository adds the same hosted server and skills.

 Claude directory: the directory listing reads the plugin from plugins/taskade/ , a copy of the root plugin files. The other hosts read the root files.

To add only the hosted server to Codex, run codex mcp add taskade --url then codex mcp login taskade .

install.title: Taskade MCP server quick start
install.html:
URL https://www.taskade.com/mcp
Transport Streamable HTTP
Auth OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and dynamic client registration. Your client opens a Taskade sign-in page once.
Plan MCP access is part of every paid Taskade plan (Starter and up). On the Free plan, list_spaces returns no workspaces.
Discovery https://www.taskade.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp

An initialize request without a token returns 401 on purpose. The 401 tells your client where to start the OAuth sign-in.

Claude (web, Desktop and mobile)

Select Connect in Claude at the top of this page to open Taskade AI in the Claude directory. To add the server as a custom connector instead:

  1. In Claude, go to Customize > Connectors and select Add custom connector. On a Team or Enterprise plan, an Owner first adds the connector in Organization settings > Connectors (Add, then Custom).
  2. Enter the name Taskade and the URL https://www.taskade.com/mcp, then select Add.
  3. Select Connect, sign in to Taskade, and approve access.
  4. In a chat, select + > Connectors and turn on Taskade.

If the dialog asks for an OAuth client, select Register automatically. The connector also works in Claude Desktop and the Claude mobile apps on the same account.

Claude Code
claude mcp add --transport http taskade https://www.taskade.com/mcp

Then run /mcp in Claude Code and select taskade to sign in.

ChatGPT

ChatGPT connects to a remote MCP server as a custom connector in developer mode. It uses OAuth only.

  1. In ChatGPT settings, turn on developer mode for apps and connectors.
  2. Create a connector. Enter Taskade as the name and https://www.taskade.com/mcp as the server URL.
  3. Select OAuth as the authentication. Sign in to Taskade and allow access.

Developer mode is available only on some ChatGPT plans, and its labels change often.

Cursor

Select Add to Cursor at the top of this page, or add this to ~/.cursor/mcp.json:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "taskade": {
      "url": "https://www.taskade.com/mcp"
    }
  }
}
VS Code

Select Install in VS Code at the top of this page, or run:

code --add-mcp '{"name":"taskade","type":"http","url":"https://www.taskade.com/mcp"}'
Windsurf

Add this to ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "taskade": {
      "serverUrl": "https://www.taskade.com/mcp"
    }
  }
}
Other clients and servers (API token)

A client that cannot do OAuth can send a Taskade personal access token as a Bearer token. Create the token in Taskade Settings > API.

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "taskade": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://www.taskade.com/mcp",
      "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TASKADE_API_TOKEN" }
    }
  }
}

Full guide: Hosted Taskade MCP.

usage.title: Example prompts
usage.html:
1. Weekly review. "List my Taskade workspaces, read the Q4 Roadmap project, and give me the open tasks grouped by assignee." Tools: list_spaces, list_projects, read_project.
  2. Plan a launch. "Create a project called Website Launch in my Marketing workspace with tasks for copy, design, QA and launch day, and set the launch task to November 3." Tools: list_spaces, create_project, create_task, set_task_date.
  3. Build a support agent. "Create an agent called Help Bot in my Support workspace, add the FAQ project as its knowledge, then ask it how a customer resets a password." Tools: create_agent, add_knowledge_project, prompt_agent.
  4. Close out a sprint. "In the Sprint 42 project, mark every task that mentions 'shipped' as complete, then mark the project as completed." Tools: list_tasks, complete_task, complete_project.
  5. Edit a Taskade Genesis app. "In my CRM app, read app/src/App.tsx and change the page title to Acme CRM." Tools: inspect_space, write_file.
